id: HFLAT3: requirement-guided latency reduction with path separation - final controller MX vs LCMHF
registered: 2026-10-29, before any HFLAT3 run. Background: HFLAT2 L3 FAIL; HRDEV diagnosis (RESULTS_HFLAT2.md): (1) K=200 at 200 Hz = no filter, the hold force feedforward closes a loop through differenced accelerations and oscillates at Nyquist; (2) the hold freezes the robot's own planned motion (Ldot=0, z=0) during arm motion; (3) HFLAT/HFLAT2 comparator lacked RA_MOTION_FX=45. Dev (seeds 1310-1311, not reused): LCMHF ~ MX

arms.MX: final controller (DB + RA_FZMIN=0.1 + RA_MOTION_FX=45 = deploy_real R2)
arms.LCMHF: MX + decision paths fast (RA_IMU_K=200, RA2E_N=1, RA_DEC_RAW=1: capture prediction on the unfiltered estimate, force bound on the 5-tick median copy) + actuation path filtered (RA_FF_LP=0.5) + motion-consistent hold (RA_HOLD_REF=m)

cells: as HFLAT2: holdable 6, step-needed 8, successive 4, arm motion 8 (lift/swing/gesture/jab, no push and x+50 N at 3 s)

predictions.L1 more holds in place: holdable + step-needed (56 runs): zero-step holds LCMHF >= MX + 6, one-sided exact McNemar p < 0.05
predictions.L2 no loss of robustness: all 104 runs: held LCMHF >= held MX - 3
predictions.L3 no added false steps: arm motion without push (16 runs): steps LCMHF <= steps MX + 2
predictions.L4 successive pushes: successive (16 runs): held LCMHF >= held MX - 1 and steps LCMHF <= steps MX + 3

adoption: LCMHF replaces MX as the final controller only if L1-L4 all pass
secondary_reporting: tilt-bound events reported separately per arm: failure = physical_bounds with pelvis height > 0.6 m and no step in the last 0.5 s (primary outcome unchanged: held = failure is None)
